subject: shiny app with Rstudio in window mode failed to save images

messages.subject: shiny app with Rstudio in window mode failed to save images
parts:
Hi,

I noticed that a shiny app that is loaded with Rstudio is not able to save images (png, svg, pdf ...) if it is loaded as window mode.
If I run the application as "run external" in my browser, the save function will work.
Is there any solution for it ?

Thanks,
Amine
